opening.argument: The segment is a televised discussion of legal and political criticism, not a presentation of a financial opportunity. It opens with a close look at Robert Mueller’s office and turns to the investigation of Enron and Arthur Andersen. Its closing request asks viewers to watch Levin TV and sign up for a town hall. That is an audience-engagement request; the cited material states no payment, data request, or deceptive offer. The presence of a sign-up invitation does not change the character of the interview or establish a scam where no such terms or promises are stated.
